summary: Large modern apartment · Prime Gosforth location · Secure underground parking · Extensive communal gardens · Available now
description:
Modern one bedroom, ground floor apartment at the ever-popular Grove Park Oval.

My Property Box are thrilled to announce to the Lettings market this contemporary one bedroom apartment at Grove Park Oval, Gosforth. Situated only a stones throw away from Gosforth High Street, the apartment boasts a prime position in one of Newcastle's most affluent areas.

Through a secured communal entrance, the property comprises; entrance hallway with access to a storage cupboard, double bedroom with triple wardrobe, large bathroom, open plan living space featuring stunning floor-to-ceiling windows and private west-facing terrace which is ideal for a summer's day. In addition, the property comes with secure underground parking and extensive communal gardens to explore.

The apartment's quiet yet convenient location provides residents with easy access to Gosforth's plethora of bars, shops and green spaces as well as transport links to the rest of Newcastle. Available now, unfurnished. To arrange a viewing, contact MPB today and speak with the Lettings Team.
